headline: Base Lines Shift Across Contested Belt
war_summary: Since the last edition, the contested belt has quickened, with the sharpest changes at Gutter and WeatheredExpanse. Gutter now reports 57 strategic-base events in 24 hours, up from 51, and its line stands at five Warden, no Colonial, and two neutral positions after recent movement. WeatheredExpanse has risen to 41 daily events from 29, with three Warden, four Colonial, and two neutral bases; combat and enlistment rates are accelerating. NevishLine has also surged, recording eight events in the latest two hours and 27 across the day, though its seven-to-one Warden advantage is unchanged. MarbanHollow remains a mixed, active sector at three Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases, with 20 events in 24 hours. PalantineBerm has quieted from the previous report, posting 22 daily events and no activity in the latest two hours, while Godcrofts has settled at nine Colonial holdings after seven daily events. Heavy fighting continues in CallahansPassage, but no base events are reported there. No victor is declared.
